## [1.0.1](https://github.com/MohamedElnaggar00/morphe-patches-tiktok-lite-only/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (2026-10-03)

### Bug Fixes

* update TikTok Lite 47.0.3 downloads status fingerprint ([c342a74](https://github.com/MohamedElnaggar00/morphe-patches-tiktok-lite-only/commit/c342a74fb1f0a2aad349a08cf5a59358adb6f15f))

patches.name: Disable Login Requirement
patches.description: Removes TikTok Lite mandatory login gate so the app can be browsed without an account.

patches.name: Disable Telemetry
patches.description: Disables ByteDance analytics by blocking the MiniLiteApplogServiceImpl wrapper.

patches.name: Enable Duet and Stitch
patches.description: Unlocks Duet and Stitch on all videos regardless of creator permission settings.

patches.name: Feed Filter
patches.description: Removes ads, sponsored content, and commerce posts from the TikTok Lite home feed.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA Popups
patches.description: Suppresses browsing CAPTCHA dialogs from SecApiImpl.

patches.name: Hide Live Cards
patches.description: Removes live stream cards from the TikTok Lite home feed.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes feed ads, splash ads, and soft ads from TikTok Lite.

patches.name: Sanitize Share URLs
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters (utm_campaign, share_link_id) from shared links.

patches.name: Stop Video Looping
patches.description: Prevents videos from looping automatically after playback ends.
